presourcing_data.product_concept: Introducing a premium sand-free beach towel made from 100% microfiber, designed for beachgoers who want to enjoy the sun and surf without the hassle of sand sticking to their towels. Measuring 30 by 60 inches, this lightweight and compact towel is perfect for travel and outdoor activities, providing superior absorbency and quick-drying capabilities. Unlike traditional towels, our innovative design repels sand, making it easier to shake off and keep clean, setting it apart from the Utopia Towels Jumbo Bath Sheet.
presourcing_data.buyer_poll_result: our_product — Target buyers likely prefer our sand-free towel due to its unique feature that addresses a common pain point of sand sticking to traditional towels. The lightweight and compact design makes it ideal for beachgoers who value convenience and ease of use, which is not a focus for the competitor's larger bath sheet.
